description: Search the ~140-family font catalog by mood, theme or name — e.g. "horror", "kids playful", "elegant serif", "pixel arcade", "western". Every family is Google-hosted and loads automatically when referenced by name in any kind of artifact's theme (`fonts:` frontmatter) or on a text run (`font="…"`). Use it to pick type that matches the content instead of defaulting to a generic sans.

query.description: Mood/theme/name keywords; omit to list the whole catalog grouped by category

name: list_fonts
title: Browse the font catalog
